content.title: Spring Break 2026: When and where is it celebrated?- Holafly
content.text: Spring Break is fast approaching. In next to no time you’ll be soaking up the sun on the shores of the Atlantic or Mediterranean. But when is it, exactly? And where should you go in 2026, with many popular US spots starting to crack down on Spring Break celebrations. Below, we tell you your college’s dates for Spring Break 2026. Plus, we highlight the must-see destinations for every type of Spring Breaker. Let’s dive in! When does Spring Break USA start?What is Spring Break?When is Spring Break 2026 in the USA?Best Spring Break destinationsHow to get internet during Spring Break 2026?Plans that may interest you When does Spring Break USA start? Spring Break in the USA will start in early March and last until mid-April. Some colleges will start the Spring Break from March 6 to March 13, while others will start on the 13th or 20th. Spring Break will typically last 1 week, with finishing dates ranging from March 14 to April 4. In reality, your specific dates will depend on which college you’re studying at. For example, at Boston University, the break will last from March 7 to March 15; at Oklahoma State University, it will occur from March 14 to March 21. Check the dates on your academic calendar; you don’t want to miss your Monday classes because of a hangover! Spring Break is a short vacation period where universities, schools, and workplaces go for a small break, whether partying, traveling, or relaxing throughout the one to two-week vacation period. This tradition also occurs in other places, such as Latin America, where the Holy Week is considered the Spring Break. And yes, you can still party and listen to some music with your friends even if you’re traveling to that region! Spring Break was born in the 20th century, close to the 1930s, when a New York swimming coach decided to take his team to Florida for off-season training. Little did they know, it would end up being adopted by other major colleges and later turned into a celebration that involves visiting sun-filled destinations such as Florida, Texas, Cancun, Panama, or even Europe, becoming a highlight of the academic calendar. People enjoying a party during the Spring Break. Source: Pexels When is Spring Break 2026 in the USA? The dates for Spring Break 2026 in the USA will depend on your university academic calendar or local school board. Best Spring Break destinations Blocked off the Spring Break dates in your academic calendar? Here comes the fun part: choosing the best Spring Break destinations to visit. Depending on your budget, you might consider a trip to Mexico or even Europe, but that’s not to say classic Spring Break locations like Florida or Miami should be skipped. So, let’s talk about the unmissable destinations to see before you head back to university. Mexico While Mexico is a year-round destination, the Spring Break dates are an ideal time for a trip to places like Cancun or Ciudad de Mexico. Your final choice will depend on how you want to spend your vacation. Do you want to spend your days partying, drinking a nice piña colada on the beach, and enjoying the fresh air without thinking about your next math test? Then, Cancun, Cabo San Lucas, Playa del Carmen, and Puerto Vallarta are your go-to destinations. People walking to the beach in Playa del Carmen. Source: Pexels Now, if you’re looking for something more relaxed and to clear your mind of studying stresses, any location close to the Riviera Maya will do. Our take is Playa del Carmen, where beautiful beaches and archeological sites create the ideal atmosphere for an enjoyable recharge. United States Spring Break in the United States is always a foolproof option. There are several popular locations you can visit depending on what you want to do during the Spring Break. Here are some examples: Texas: South Padre Island in Texas is a major Spring Break destination for students looking for bars, live concerts, events, and vibrant nightlife. Florida: This is the ideal destination for all travelers, with locations like Siesta Beach, Delray Beach, New Smyrna Beach, and Fort Lauderdale waiting for some wild partying days. If you’re looking forward to saying “Sorry for party rocking” like LMFAO, the nightlife and Spring Break events will carry you through your vacations, or you could plan a family trip and enjoy some nice restaurants and hotels. Los Angeles: LA has something for everyone. Here, you can party at El Matador Beach or Venice Beach with your friends, explore local museums like the Los Angeles County Museum of Art, or do a science stop at the Griffith Observatory. Florida is a go-to destination for the Spring Break. Source: Unsplash Europe If your budget can stretch a little further, and your Spring Break lasts a little longer than others, Europe is an increasingly popular alternative to the parties of Cancun or Miami Beach. Some top destinations include: Spain: With destinations like Alicante, Ibiza, or Huelva, partying never stops in Spain. You’ll find events from the second week of March until early June, and you can combine these with a day on the beach, relaxing at your preferred hotel, or getting to know these destinations a lot more. Greece: Greece is mostly a spring destination and is home to some of the best islands in all of Europe. You surely won’t miss the chance to visit the colorful island of Mykonos, enjoy clear-water beaches, and take some pictures of the white yet colorful city before heading to a club at night. Netherlands: Before going back to classes, a visit to Amsterdam is a great plan. You can’t miss the chance to enjoy a European rave before getting your culture fix over a long weekend. Portugal: Looking for a more relaxed plan? Portugal is a great stop for those looking for a calm getaway. With mild temperatures, cities like Lisbon, Porto, and Braga are great destinations for a Spring Break getaway. Spring Breakers taking in the sun on a sandy beach.
